SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in the well-known NAT64 prefix

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::{scrape, shutdown_engine};
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"ssrf\":{\"deny_private\":true},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"http://[64:ff9b::7f00:1]/"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await;
    shutdown_engine(engine).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
